dialogues.jp: 白い夢。
dialogues.en: A white dream.
dialogues.text: A white dream.

dialogues.jp: 本当になにもない。
dialogues.en: There's nothing there.
dialogues.text: There's nothing there.

dialogues.jp: 虚無の夢。
dialogues.en: A dream of an absolute nothingness.
dialogues.text: A dream of an absolute nothingness.

dialogues.jp: 上も下もないところに、俺だけが立っている。
dialogues.en: I'm standing in a space.
dialogues.text: I'm standing in a space.

dialogues.jp: こんな夢に出会ったのは初めてだ……。
dialogues.en: I've never had a dream like this......
dialogues.text: I've never had a dream like this......

dialogues.jp: 「これは……」
dialogues.en: "What's this......"
dialogues.text: "What's this......"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: （もちろん音夢ちゃんの夢）
dialogues.en: (This is Nemu-chan's dream.)
dialogues.text: (This is Nemu-chan's dream.)

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「さくら……どこだ」
dialogues.en: "Sakura...... Where are you?"
dialogues.text: "Sakura...... Where are you?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
（無理だよ。もう、音夢ちゃんの中では芳乃さ
　くらという人間は記憶されてないの）
dialogues.en: (It's impossible. Nemu-chan doesn't remember me anymore.)
dialogues.text: (It's impossible. Nemu-chan doesn't remember me anymore.)

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: （声も忘れちゃったらしいね）
dialogues.en: (She doesn't recognize my voice either.)
dialogues.text: (She doesn't recognize my voice either.)

dialogues.jp:
確かに、さくらの声は文字としてでしか知覚で
きない。
dialogues.en:
As she said, I can't hear her voice, but I can visualize
what she's saying.
dialogues.text:
As she said, I can't hear her voice, but I can visualize
what she's saying.

dialogues.jp: 「これは夢なんてもんじゃ――」
dialogues.en: "This isn't even a dream..."
dialogues.text: "This isn't even a dream..."

dialogues.jp: ぞっとした。
dialogues.en: It scared me to death.
dialogues.text: It scared me to death.

dialogues.jp: 音が伸びない。
dialogues.en: My voice doesn't spread.
dialogues.text: My voice doesn't spread.

dialogues.jp:
なにもない空間では、声が反響することなく無
限に消えていく。
dialogues.en:
My voice is sucked into the nothingness without echoing
since there's nothing to echo on.
dialogues.text:
My voice is sucked into the nothingness without echoing
since there's nothing to echo on.

dialogues.jp: 「これが夢？　こんなからっぽなのが夢か？」
dialogues.en: "Is this a dream? Can a dream be so empty?"
dialogues.text: "Is this a dream? Can a dream be so empty?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: （そうだよ）
dialogues.en: (Yes.)
dialogues.text: (Yes.)

dialogues.jp: 冷たい文字。
dialogues.en: The letters seemed so cold.
dialogues.text: The letters seemed so cold.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
（もぅ、音夢ちゃんが覚えているのはお兄ちゃ
　んのことだけ）
dialogues.en: (The only thing Nemu remembers about is you now.)
dialogues.text: (The only thing Nemu remembers about is you now.)

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
（残された｛わず／僅｝かな｛かけら／欠片｝を守るために、他のどん
　な記憶ですらも犠牲にしている……）
dialogues.en:
(She's sacrificing all other memories to protect the small
memories she still has with you.)
dialogues.text:
(She's sacrificing all other memories to protect the small
memories she still has with you.)

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「あいつ、お前のことまで忘れたって言うの
　か？」
dialogues.en: "Nemu forgot about you?"
dialogues.text: "Nemu forgot about you?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
（限界なんだよ……そこまでしないと守れない
　んだ）
dialogues.en:
(It's too overwhelming for her...... she has to go to that
extent to protect it.)
dialogues.text:
(It's too overwhelming for her...... she has to go to that
extent to protect it.)

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「そこまでして守るものなのか！？」
dialogues.en: "Does she need to go that far to protect it?"
dialogues.text: "Does she need to go that far to protect it?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「俺との想い出だってあらかた消えているのに、
　あいつは一体、どんな夢を守ってるんだ！？」
dialogues.en:
"She doesn't have most of the memories with me either.
What's she trying to protect after all this?"
dialogues.text:
"She doesn't have most of the memories with me either.
What's she trying to protect after all this?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: （過去じゃないんだよ）
dialogues.en: (It's not about the past.)
dialogues.text: (It's not about the past.)

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: （過去の夢じゃなくて、未来の夢）
dialogues.en: (The dream isn't about the past, but the future.)
dialogues.text: (The dream isn't about the past, but the future.)

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
（過去じゃなくたって、未来に希望をもってい
　るから人は生きられる）
dialogues.en:
(We can live because we have hopes in the future, not in the
past.)
dialogues.text:
(We can live because we have hopes in the future, not in the
past.)

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: （たったひとつ）
dialogues.en: (Only one wish.)
dialogues.text: (Only one wish.)

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: （ささやかな願いごとだよ）
dialogues.en: (It's a small wish.)
dialogues.text: (It's a small wish.)

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: （笑っちゃうくらいささやかなんだよ……）
dialogues.en: (It's so small you might laugh......)
dialogues.text: (It's so small you might laugh......)

dialogues.jp: ぽっ、と暖かい感覚。
dialogues.en: I felt warm feelings.
dialogues.text: I felt warm feelings.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: （だから、叶えてあげてお兄ちゃん）
dialogues.en: (Make it come true for her, oniichan.)
dialogues.text: (Make it come true for her, oniichan.)

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
（それは奇跡なんかじゃなくて、とっても簡単
　なことなんだけど）
dialogues.en: (It's not even a miracle, but a simple thing.)
dialogues.text: (It's not even a miracle, but a simple thing.)

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: （お兄ちゃんにしか叶えられないんだ）
dialogues.en: (You're the only one who can make it come true for her.)
dialogues.text: (You're the only one who can make it come true for her.)

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: （音夢ちゃんの夢を叶えてあげて……）
dialogues.en: (Make Nemu-chan's dream come true......)
dialogues.text: (Make Nemu-chan's dream come true......)

dialogues.jp: ◆叶えてあげたい願い◆
dialogues.en: ◆A wish I want to make come true◆
dialogues.text: ◆A wish I want to make come true◆

dialogues.jp:
現実には最近会っていなかったが、夢の中でさ
くらにあった。
dialogues.en:
I haven't seen Sakura in real life for a while, but I talked
to her in the dream.
dialogues.text:
I haven't seen Sakura in real life for a while, but I talked
to her in the dream.

dialogues.jp:
音夢の夢を介していて、すでに声もない世界で
さくらが俺にお願いをする。
dialogues.en:
She showed up in Nemu's dream. Sakura asked me a favor in
the dream of nothingness.
dialogues.text:
She showed up in Nemu's dream. Sakura asked me a favor in
the dream of nothingness.

dialogues.jp:
俺にしか叶えられない、音夢のちっちゃな夢を
知って欲しいと――。
dialogues.en:
She wants me to make Nemu's small dream come true. And I'm
the only one who can make it come true.
dialogues.text:
She wants me to make Nemu's small dream come true. And I'm
the only one who can make it come true.
